description: If you communicate product strategy, portfolio plans, or quarterly initiatives in Power BI, you need a roadmap, not a Gantt chart. ProRoadmap helps you turn roadmap data into executive-ready planning views with quarter timelines, swimlanes, milestones, hierarchy, status colors, and Goal/OKR context - all built directly inside Power BI. Use ProRoadmap to keep stakeholders aligned on what is planned and when, show ownership and strategy at a glance, and run quarterly planning reviews without exporting to slides. For example, group initiatives by team or product area in swimlanes, color items by On Track / At Risk / Behind / Done, and surface owner, priority, and confidence in rich tooltips - so executives understand both the plan and the risk in one view. Unlike task-level Gantt visuals or static slide-based roadmaps, ProRoadmap is built for strategic communication: it focuses on themes, epics, initiatives, and milestones across quarters rather than day-level scheduling or dependency networks. Roadmap data refreshes live from your Power BI dataset, so what stakeholders see is always current. Key Features Quarter-first roadmap timeline - year, quarter, and month scale layers designed for strategic planning, so you communicate plans by quarter without forcing day-level precision.
